notes: Local production; Lighthouse mobile simulated throttling; optimizer caches can be warm.
Baseline samples precede decorative-priority hints; matched-CSS control samples deliberately disable hints; final/candidate samples retain them.
Normal and reduced motion are explicit and verified in the measured document.
Interaction timings include automation overhead and are not field INP or compositor FPS.
A concurrent portrait-media pairing rule adds 116 bytes shared CSS; matched-CSS controls retain it to isolate priority changes.
The case-priority-before samples precede D046; case-panel samples add the panel hint only; case-font samples retain font and panel hints.

D047 image-size hints change full-reading responsive image transfers, not the initial Lighthouse image inventory. The reduced sample overlapped lint execution; do not attribute score movement to sizing.
